root_cause: The Checkboxes component only attaches a 'click' event listener to the root element. Exclusive behavior (unchecking other boxes when a 'None of these' checkbox is checked) runs only in the click handler, so keyboard interaction (Space/Enter) that changes the checkbox state does not trigger the logic, leaving previously checked symptoms selected. Additionally, the unCheckExclusiveInputs method incorrectly selects only exclusive inputs with the same name, failing to clear non-exclusive symptom checkboxes when the exclusive checkbox has a different name but shares the same exclusive group.
repair_strategy: Replace the click event listener with a change event listener to capture both mouse and keyboard interactions. Rewrite unCheckExclusiveInputs to uncheck all other checkboxes in the same exclusive group (or same name if no group) when an exclusive checkbox is checked. When a regular checkbox is checked, uncheck any exclusive checkboxes in the same group.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can now select the 'No symptoms' exclusive checkbox and have any previously selected symptom checkboxes automatically cleared, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order). Mouse clicking continues to work as before.
functional_risks: The change event fires for programmatic changes, but the handler returns early when the checkbox is unchecked, so no adverse effect is expected.
The new group-based selection might affect other checkbox groups if they share the same group attribute unexpectedly, but the attribute is designed for this purpose.
Removing the unCheckAllInputsExcept method could affect any external code calling it, but it appears to be private to the component.
verification_requirements: Using only the keyboard (Tab to navigate, Space to check), verify that checking cough and fever then checking 'No symptoms' clears cough and fever.
Verify that mouse clicking continues to work as before.
Confirm that conditional reveals linked via aria-controls still synchronize correctly for both mouse and keyboard interactions.
Ensure no errors are thrown when initializing the component on pages that use it.
Verify the regression guard: choosing 'Do not contact me' after ticking a contact method works.
